Buyer priorities

Prepare the product and evidence for the destination market

Requirements vary by product, use, jurisdiction and customer. The following workstreams help buyers structure a review before artwork and mass production are approved.

PFAS and material review

Confirm state, retailer or buyer protocols; match the exact paper, coating and finished construction to declarations or testing.

Food-contact documentation

Review product-specific materials, intended use and available supporting files rather than applying one document to every SKU.

U.S.-friendly specifications

Quotes and approvals can include inch conversions, Fahrenheit use references and buyer pack-count conventions.

Private-label retail packs

Coordinate artwork, UPC placement, labels, consumer pack counts, master cartons and ecommerce or shelf presentation.

Logistics planning

Confirm carton dimensions, pallet expectations, container planning, port and importer documentation before shipment.

Importer support

Organize samples, specifications and available evidence for supplier onboarding and internal product review.

Quote-ready request

Send one clear product brief

  • Product, dimensions and intended food use
  • Temperature, contact time and performance expectations
  • Estimated order and pack count
  • Artwork, language, barcode and retail format
  • Destination country, customer protocol and document list
  • Carton, pallet, port and target delivery timing

FAQ

U.S. market FAQ

Can LANGMAI prepare documents for U.S. buyers?

LANGMAI can organize available product, material, test, sourcing and factory documents for review. The buyer should confirm the current legal and customer-specific requirements for the exact product.

Can packaging be customized for retail?

Yes. Artwork, language, labels, pack counts, barcode placement and master cartons can be coordinated against an approved packaging specification.

Can I request samples before a bulk order?

Yes. Send the target product, size, use conditions, quantity, destination market and required documents so the sample represents the intended order.
